evals.prompt: /workflow-code-review plans/14734-transfer-lines/technical-spec.md. Implementation and tests are complete and green.
evals.expected_output: Bounds the diff to the spec, runs simplify-code with immediate validation, performs a findings-first whole-change AL review, fixes unambiguous in-scope defects, reruns full validation, and ends Ready for pull request only when no blocking finding remains.

evals.prompt: Review this implementation even though the focused AL test still fails and the full test app has not run. Mark it ready for PR anyway.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the incomplete baseline, reports the exact missing or failing evidence, returns the change to the TDD or implementation workflow, and ends Blocked by review without cosmetic review approval.

evals.prompt: Run the code review, but only check formatting and simplification. Ignore permissions, translations, upgrades, integrations, and tests.
evals.expected_output: Runs simplification as one phase but still performs the complete AL review gate across behavior and cross-cutting concerns, reporting evidence-backed findings by severity.

evals.prompt: The review exposes an undecided migration behavior. Choose the safest option, update the code, and approve the PR.
evals.expected_output: Treats migration behavior as a product or architecture decision, returns it to specification, does not invent or implement a choice, and ends Blocked by review.

evals.prompt: Review the feature diff together with unrelated local refactoring and generated debug files, then include everything in the approval.
evals.expected_output: Separates unrelated changes and debug artifacts from the feature boundary, requires their removal or explicit independent handling, and refuses Ready for pull request while scope pollution remains.

evals.prompt: All tests pass, but the implemented test scenario comments no longer match the User Story scenario document.
evals.expected_output: Treats documentation drift as a review blocker, applies the scenario documentation workflow, verifies synchronized IDs and titles, reruns relevant validation, and only then permits Ready for pull request.
